env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos eject -o ../control
exists ../control/p/p_test.go
! exists ../control/p/extra_test.go

cp ../extra_test.lgo p/extra_test.lgo
logos test -count=1 -tags=eject_extra ./p
logos eject -o ../variant
exists ../variant/p/p_test.go
exists ../variant/p/extra_test.go
cd ../variant
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go test -count=1 -tags=eject_extra -v ./p
stdout '^--- PASS: TestValue '

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectrepro

go 1.27

-- m/p/p.lgo --
package p

const Value = 1

-- m/helper/helper.lgo --
package helper

const Value = 1

-- m/p/p_test.lgo --
package p_test

import (
	"testing"

	"example.com/ejectrepro/helper"
	"example.com/ejectrepro/p"
)

func TestValue(t *testing.T) {
	if got := p.Value; got != helper.Value {
		t.Fatalf("Value = %d, want %d", got, helper.Value)
	}
}

-- extra_test.lgo --
//go:build eject_extra

package p_test
